name: authorize_team_sso
description:
Create a single-use Vercel consent link, valid for 10 minutes, to authorize this connection's existing app permissions for a team. Works for teams with or without SSO; the browser completes SSO when the team requires it. Does not grant access by itself.
Use when the connection lacks the target team's grant or its team SSO session has expired. The user opens the link and approves; afterward the original request can be retried on this same connection. A granted team is shared across this user's connections to the same app.

teamId.description: The ID or slug of the team to authorize, usually the `teamId` from the failed request.
